title: Host cluster: TermAl knows enrolled hosts' capabilities, toolchains, capacity and project availability, and routes ready, safely delegatable work to them
outcome: A reviewed design (design first; no implementation before Greg accepts it and it is sliced) for a universal host cluster. TermAl's central control plane knows every enrolled host's capabilities, toolchains, capacity and project availability, and routes ready, safely delegatable work to a suitable host. The central TermAl control plane and the decentralized Engram/Git boundary are kept, and human and authority gates are unchanged.
acceptance: A design note on this epic defines the host capability/toolchain/capacity/project-availability inventory (built on the satellite registry and onboarding verification of the cross-host mailbox design) and how it stays current.

The design defines which work is 'ready and safely delegatable' and the routing/placement rules, including refusal when no verified host fits, without changing any human or authority gate (commit, push, install, restart, approval).
The design keeps the central TermAl control plane and the decentralized Engram/Git task boundary, and states failure behaviour (host lost mid-task, capacity exhausted, stale inventory).
Greg accepts the design before any slice is filed or implemented.
